Plasticky/oversmoothed skin (no visible pores, artifacts 4-5) is PLATFORM-WIDE on MLX-quantized bases (zimage-moody 4-bit AND flux2-klein INT8) — NOT a LoRA side-effect. Do NOT A/B LoRAs expecting skin-realism gains on hard skin-heavy prompts.

Skin-detail levers PARTIALLY exhausted (2026-06-20): at 640×960, LoRA scale/steps/seed/base-swap/realism-LoRAs leave artifacts 4-5. BUT RESOLUTION was never tested — it is a WORKING lever (artifacts 4-5 @ 640×960 → 8-10 @ 1024×1536, mean 9.3). Do not conclude 'exhausted' without sweeping resolution AND transformer/steps/cfg.

SELF-LEARN KEY FACTORS, not seeds: the actionable levers are TRANSFORMER (which ZIT checkpoint) · steps · cfg · resolution · VAE · LoRA. Seed variance is luck (random init) — A/B-ing seeds alone teaches nothing. Vary ONE real lever, hold the rest fixed. Seed sweeps are only for best-of-N selection.

Build transformer knowledge from TWO sources: (1) author recs from the checkpoint download URL / model card (recommended steps/cfg/resolution/scale — store in the model manifest.json source_url + recommended_*), (2) our empirical A/B tests. Combine both per-transformer; don't rely on author recs unverified, don't ignore them either.
UltraFlux 4K VAE (app default) is 2.2x sharper than standard zimage-ae but noisier/blockier — neither clears the artifacts>=6 pore gate. VAE is NOT the skin fix.
